From D4C Love Train · Price: you must stand in a shaft of light and it only redirects, never prevents.

Theme Fate

  • 1: Reaction, surge: when you take damage, half goes to a creature within 30 ft instead (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates); once per round.
  • 5: On a failure you redirect all of it.
  • 9: You can also redirect one condition you would gain from the same effect.
  • 13: Range 60 ft.
  • 17: Redirect to two creatures.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
